answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1 exclusive service vertex, acting as a jetty for authorized traffic. An honest agent maintains this singular reservation at a steady cost, whereas 1,000 fakes must pay an immense, non-linear sum to hold such parallel capacity. A verifier monitors the prism of session logs to identify occupancy overlaps; any confirmed breach triggers immediate, permanent account revocation. This mechanism ensures that identity creation remains prohibitively expensive, as the cost for 1,000 fakes scales linearly with the infrastructure required to avoid detection.
